name: Isabel Santos
title: Licensed Real Estate Salesperson
bio: Isabel grew up in Brooklyn and has watched its neighborhoods evolve from the inside. She specializes in Park Slope, Prospect Heights, and Crown Heights — areas she loves for their townhouse stock, community feel, and access to Prospect Park. She's particularly skilled with brownstone transactions and works with a network of inspectors, attorneys, and contractors who make the process seamless from offer to move-in.

testimonials.quote: Isabel found us our Park Slope brownstone in a market where nothing was available. She knew about the listing three days before it hit Zillow. We'd still be looking without her.
testimonials.author: Gabrielle & Tom F.

testimonials.quote: We were nervous about a two-family in Crown Heights — it was a big step up from renting. Isabel held our hand through every inspection, every negotiation, every form. We couldn't have done it without her.
testimonials.author: Omar A.
